test_title: PYST 57: SSC GD Constable - English (Held On - 23 Feb, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the word segment that substitutes (replaces) the bracketed word segment correctly and completes the sentence meaningfully. Select the option 'no correction required' if the sentence is correct as given.

'This must be it, it's the (countryside; might be that is our) holiday home,' she added hopefully.

options.text: countryside; however this is seemed our

solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. "countryside; perhaps this is our".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The replacement phrase should logically and meaningfully complete the sentence.
 
• The phrase "perhaps this is our" fits well with the hopeful tone indicated by the word "hopefully".
 
• The other options do not fit logically or grammatically.
 
• Option 4 is incorrect because the original phrase is unclear and awkward.

Hence, the correct answer is option 2.
